summary: The RoleConstants file defines a set of constant string values representing distinct user roles within the HSPnet.UI system.
purpose: To centralize and standardize the role identifiers used throughout the application, ensuring consistency and maintainability when referencing specific user roles.
business_rules: Role identifiers must be referenced using the constants defined in RoleConstants to avoid errors and maintain consistency.
system_behavior: The system uses RoleConstants to represent and check user roles throughout the HSPnet.UI application.
dependencies: Any feature or component requiring role checks or assignments depends on RoleConstants for consistency.
content_gaps: No workflow, validation, calculation, or exception logic is present.
No details about what each role represents or the permissions associated with each.
